name: List Workplaces
description: List Tomo workplaces from the registry (local / tunnel / SSH) — not filesystem paths.

function.name: list_workplaces
function.description: Return workplaces this agent can use (id, name, kind, online/status, path or host). Use this instead of bash find/ls to discover hosts. For tunnels, prefer online ones and pass workplace=<id|name|hostname> on bash.

kind.description: Filter by kind (default all allowed for this agent).

online_only.description: If true, only tunnels/SSH that are currently connected/reachable.
